text:
The median asking rent in Nuremberg stands at 12.89 €/m², up 4.0 % year‑on‑year and 23.3 % over the past five years, placing the city 14th among the 37 most expensive markets. The inter‑quartile range runs from 11.13 €/m² to 14.92 €/m², and a typical 60 m² unit costs about 773 € per month.

With a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and 31 days on market, the sector is balanced but tight; 18 % of listings are let within a week. Rent‑to‑income pressure remains moderate at 17.1 % for two‑resident households, though asking rents sit 57 % above existing rents (8.21 €/m²).

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 13.55 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 13.24 €/m² and 13.85 €/m², implying a 5.1 % increase.
